sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MID-LEVEL ANTICYCLONE CENTERED OVER THE MID-MS VALLEY WILL WEAKEN AS A BELT OF STRONGER WLY MID-LEVEL FLOW EXTENDS FROM THE NRN PLAINS EWD INTO THE NERN U.S. AN UPPER LOW OVER SRN ALBERTA WILL MOVE EWD WITH ENHANCED FORCING FOR ASCENT BRUSHING THE NRN PLAINS. FARTHER EAST...AN UPPER LEVEL TROUGH WILL MOVE EWD OFF THE COAST OF NEW ENGLAND. THE SURFACE COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH THE NERN U.S. UPPER TROUGH WILL MOVE OFF THE COAST BY 25/00Z AND EXTEND FROM THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES NWWD INTO SD. THE WWD EXTENSION OF THE FRONT WILL REMAIN NEARLY STNRY ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS AS A SFC LOW STRENGTHENS OVER SD. ...MID-ATLANTIC STATES WWD THROUGH THE OHIO VALLEY AND INTO THE NRN PLAINS... SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF SVR TSTMS WILL LIKELY RESULT IN AN ACTIVE SVR WX DAY AS STRONGER FLOW ALOFT INTERACTS WITH MOD-STG INSTABILITY AND FOCUSED CONVERGENCE ALONG THE FRONT AND PRE-FRONTAL TROUGH. STG/ISOLD SVR TSTMS MAY BE ONGOING AT 24/12Z ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE UPPER MIDWEST/LOWER GREAT LAKES REGION. THIS CONVECTION WILL MOST PROBABLY WEAKEN SOMEWHAT DURING THE MORNING HOURS AS IT MOVES SE INTO THE OHIO VALLEY. AS DAYTIME HEATING COMMENCES...EXPECT SVR TSTMS TO DEVELOP/REINTENSIFY ACROSS THE OHIO VALLEY AND M

sections.title: IL/INDIANA TO THE MID ATLANTIC TODAY
sections.text: AN MCS HAS PERSISTED ACROSS NE IL/NW INDIANA THIS MORNING AS THE CONVECTION MOVES THROUGH A CORRIDOR OF RICHER BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE/MODERATE INSTABILITY ALONG A SURFACE FRONT. THESE STORMS HAVE ALSO BEEN SUPPORTED BY A BELT OF ENHANCED MIDLEVEL FLOW/SHEAR ALONG THE FRONT...AND THE RISK OF AT LEAST ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS MAY CONTINUE THROUGH MID-LATE MORNING ACROSS NRN INDIANA BEFORE THE STORMS ENCOUNTER THE RECENTLY RAIN-COOLED AREA WITH OVERNIGHT WAA STORMS. ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT WILL BE POSSIBLE LATER THIS AFTERNOON ALONG THE SURFACE FRONT /REINFORCED BY OUTFLOW WITH THE MORNING MCS/ AND THE DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ZONE FROM CENTRAL IL SEWD ACROSS SRN INDIANA INTO KY. OTHERWISE...A SURFACE COLD FRONT ACROSS THE LOWER GREAT LAKES/SAINT LAWRENCE VALLEY WILL MOVE SEWD TO THE NEW ENGLAND COAST BY THIS EVENING...IMMEDIATELY IN ADVANCE OF A MIDLEVEL TROUGH MOVING ESEWD FROM ONTARIO/QUEBEC. THE FRONT IS PRECEDED BY A SURFACE LEE TROUGH FROM SE NEW ENGLAND SWWD TO VA AND THE PIEDMONT OF NC. THE RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE /BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS OF 68-72 F/ COVERS A BROAD AREA FROM CENTRAL PA AND OH SWD/SWWD. THIS MOISTURE WILL COMBINE WITH DAYTIME HEATING AND RESULT IN STRONG IN

sections.title: SE NEW ENGLAND THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: CLOUD BREAKS WILL ALLOW SUBSTANTIAL SURFACE HEATING TODAY IN ADVANCE OF THE COLD FRONT...WHERE BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS REMAIN IN THE UPPER 60S ACROSS SE NEW ENGLAND. FRONTAL PASSAGE WILL OCCUR THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS SE NEW ENGLAND...AT WHICH TIME MODERATE INSTABILITY WILL BE PRESENT /MLCAPE AOA 1500 J PER KG/ WITH WLY EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AROUND 25 KT. VEERED LOW-LEVEL FLOW AND ONLY WEAK ASCENT ALONG THE FRONT SUGGEST THAT STORM COVERAGE WILL BE SOMEWHAT SPARSE...BUT ANY STORMS THAT DEVELOP WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE DAMAGING WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: A PRONOUNCED MIDLEVEL LOW OVER SRN SK...WITH A VORTICITY LOBE EXTENDING SWD OVER NW MT...WILL PROGRESS EWD OVER MT/SK BY TONIGHT. A SURFACE COLD FRONT WILL MOVE EWD TO NEAR THE MT/ND BORDER BY ABOUT 00Z...WHILE A REMNANT LEE CYCLONE DRIFTS EWD NEAR THE NEB/SD BORDER. BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW-MID 60S AND SURFACE HEATING IN CLOUD BREAKS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MLCAPE NEAR 1500 J/KG ACROSS WRN ND...AND SOMEWHAT LARGER BUOYANCY FARTHER S NEAR THE LEE CYCLONE AND A STALLED FRONT IN SD. THERE IS SOME UNCERTAINTY REGARDING STORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON ALONG THE SURFACE COLD FRONT GIVEN THE CURRENT CLOUD COVER AND CONVECTION NEAR THE MT/ND BORDER...VERSUS STORM DEVELOPMENT E OF THE CLOUDS IN ND. IN EITHER CASE...EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR IN THE 30-40 KT RANGE...IN COMBINATION WITH MODERATE INSTABILITY...WILL SUPPORT A RISK FOR ORGANIZED LINE SEGMENTS AND MORE DISCRETE SUPERCELLS WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS/LARGE HAIL. ..THOMPSON/MOSIER.. 07/24/2012

sections.title: MIDWEST TO THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION
sections.text: A COMPLEX CONVECTIVE FCST HAS EVOLVED ACROSS THE REGION THIS AFTN AND THERE WILL BE POTENTIALLY ONE OR MORE AREAS OF INTEREST THAT DEVELOP AND REQUIRE VERY SHORT-TERM FINE-TUNING OF THE OTLK THROUGH THIS EVE. PLEASE REFER TO MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS /ACUS11/ AND CONVECTIVE WATCHES FOR FURTHER INFORMATION. FIRST CONCERN HAS REVOLVED AROUND THE LINEAR MCS LOCATED OVER SW OH AT 16Z. STORMS HAVE BEEN MAINTAINED AS NEAR-SFC INFLOW IMPINGES ON ASSOCIATED COLD POOL FROM THE WSW. PARCELS FEEDING THE MCS ARE LIKELY CHARACTERIZED BY MUCAPE OF 2000-2500 J/KG. THE VERY MOIST LLVL AIR MASS AND STEEP MID-LVL LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT EXTENDS ESE INTO MUCH OF THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION/CAROLINAS. MEAN 850-500 MB FLOW SUGGESTS THAT THE MCS WILL CONTINUE ESE THROUGH EXTREME SRN OH/KY AND INTO SWRN VA AND UPSTATE NC/SC BY THIS EVE. SYSTEM WILL LIKELY BE ACCOMPANIED BY DMGG WIND GUSTS AND HAIL WITH ANY FORWARD-PROPAGATING BOWING STRUCTURES. ADDITIONALLY...INDIVIDUAL CELLS ALONG THE TRAILING SW FRINGE OF THE MCS MAY POSE AN ISOLD TORNADO RISK...PARTICULARLY OVER PORTIONS OF NRN KY GIVEN A DECENT VEERING PROFILE BETWEEN SFC-3KM AMIDST A MOIST ENVIRONMENT. IN WAKE OF THIS MCS...REGION ACROSS IND NWWD INTO THE UP

sections.title: SE NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: CLOUD-FREE ZONES ALONG/SE OF THE SEWD MOVING CDFNT WERE BEGINNING TO BE INITIATION AREAS FOR TSTMS ACROSS DOWNEAST MAINE TO THE MID-HUDSON VLY OF NY AT 16Z. LATEST SHORT-TERM MODELS HANG ON TO THE MID-UPR 60S SFC DEW POINTS OVER SE NEW ENGLAND THROUGH THE AFTN WITH STRONGEST DEEP-LAYER DRY ADVECTION RELEGATED TO AREAS FARTHER SW IN NE PA/NEW YORK METRO. MLCAPE TO 1500 J/KG AND WLY BULK SHEAR OF 25-30 KTS WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT SCTD TSTMS ALONG THE FRONT AND A FEW OF THESE STORMS MAY PRODUCE DMGG WIND GUSTS/HAIL ACROSS SERN NEW ENGLAND THROUGH THIS EVE.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: VERTICALLY STACKED UPR LOW OVER CNTRL ALBERTA AT MID-DAY WILL MOVE TO SRN SASKATCHEWAN BY TONIGHT. MODEST SPOKE OF VORTICITY EXTENDING S OVER NWRN MT WILL PROGRESS EWD OVER MT THROUGH TONIGHT WITH ASSOCIATED CDFNT ARRIVING ALONG THE MT/ND BORDER BY 00Z. REMNANT 1007 MB LOW OVER SWRN SD WILL DRIFT NEWD THROUGH SRN SD WITH A WRMFNT EXTENDING EWD INTO SRN MN. LLVL AIR MASS CHARACTERIZED BY LWR/MID 60S SFC DEW POINTS AND MLCAPE OF 1500-2000 J/KG WILL WRAP E/N OF THE CYCLONE CENTER THROUGH THIS AFTN. HEATING AND INCREASING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT WILL AID IN SEVERAL POTENTIAL INITIATION ZONES. ONE WILL BE NEAR THE SFC LOW AND EWD ALONG THE WRMFNT. ANOTHER WILL BE ALONG THE CDFNT FROM SRN SASKATCHEWAN SWD TO ALONG THE MT/ND BORDER. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 30-40 KTS IN COMBINATION WITH MDT INSTABILITY WILL SUPPORT RISK FOR ORGANIZED LINE SEGMENTS AND DISCRETE SUPERCELLS WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR DMGG WINDS AND LARGE HAIL. AN ISOLD TORNADO WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH EARLY ACTIVITY VCNTY THE SFC LOW/WRMFNT ALONG THE SD/ND BORDER. ..RACY/COHEN.. 07/24/2012

sections.title: MIDWEST TO THE MID-ATLANTIC
sections.text: ADJUSTED SLIGHT RISK TO AREAS E/SE OF A WEAK SURFACE CYCLONE INVOF IL/IND/KY BORDER ALONG REMNANT CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW/EFFECTIVE COLD FRONT. POTENTIAL DOES EXIST FOR ANOTHER MCS TO FORM ALONG THIS BOUNDARY TO THE WEST OF MCS CLUSTERS IN THE MID-ATLANTIC/SRN APPALACHIANS AND CAROLINAS. SEE MCD 1571 FOR A THOROUGH SHORT-TERM DISCUSSION. DOWNGRADED THE SLIGHT RISK IN PARTS OF IL AS THIS CORRIDOR SHOULD LIE IN A REGION OF LOW-LEVEL DIVERGENCE...AS MORE SUBSTANTIAL LOW-LEVEL MASS RESPONSE/WAA OCCURS TO THE N AND E.

sections.title: SE NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: SEVERE RISK HERE WILL END SHORTLY AS COLD FRONT EXITS THE COAST IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: PREVIOUS FORECAST REASONING ON TRACK. EXPANDED SLIGHT RISK PROBABILITIES A BIT FARTHER NE FOR LATE TONIGHT AS MODELS REMAIN INSISTENT ON MCS DEVELOPMENT ALONG AND N OF THE ADVANCING WARM FRONT FROM THE DAKOTAS INTO NRN/CNTRL MN. ..GRAMS.. 07/24/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1126 AM CDT TUE JUL 24 2012/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SMALL MCS MAY POSE A MARGINAL WIND THREAT OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS IT TRAVELS INTO WRN OH. ANOTHER WATCH IS BEING CONSIDERED FOR SW OH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CLUSTER OF STORMS CONTINUES TO MOVE RAPIDLY SEWD ACROSS NRN/ERN IND AT OVER 50 KT. WIND DAMAGE WAS PREVIOUSLY REPORTED ACROSS NWRN IND EARLIER THIS MORNING...AND MARGINALLY SEVERE WINDS NEAR 50 KT WERE RECENTLY REPORTED. THE STORMS WERE PRECEDED BY A N/S ORIENTED BATCH OF STORMS...WHICH HAS STABILIZED THE LOW LEVELS SOMEWHAT FOR THE SHORT TERM OVER ERN IND AND WRN OH. WARMER AIR DOES EXIST JUST TO THE SW OF THE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM...HOWEVER...850 MB FLOW IS OUT OF THE NW...INDICATING THAT THE SYSTEM MAY BE FED ABOVE THIS LEVEL WHERE WINDS ARE MORE WLY. THEREFORE...THERE MAY NOT BE MUCH INTENSIFICATION UNTIL CLEARING AND/OR ADVECTION CAN BRING A MORE UNSTABLE AIR MASS INTO CLOSER PROXIMITY OF THIS SYSTEM. ..JEWELL.. 07/24/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A NEW SVR TSTM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED DOWNSTREAM OF WW 508 WITHIN THE HOUR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SQUALL LINE WITH A HISTORY OF DMGG WIND GUSTS ACROSS W-CNTRL OH AND ERN IND WILL CONTINUE ADVANCING SEWD/SSEWD AT 60-65 MPH INTO A DESTABILIZING AIR MASS OVER THE OHIO VALLEY. WITH STRONG DEEP SHEAR AND STRONG INSTABILITY...THE FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS WILL POTENTIALLY OFFER A LONG-LIVED THREAT FOR WIDESPREAD DMGG WIND GUSTS AS THE LINE CROSSES PARTS OF KY/WV/VA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY AND A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED SOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DESTABILIZATION CONTINUES ACROSS THE REGION WITH POCKETS OF HEATING AND MIXING. EARLY CELLS CROSSING FROM SWRN PA INTO MD DID NOT PERSIST...BUT CIN WILL CONTINUE TO DECREASE...AND DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS TO FORM WHICH COULD TRACK FOR LONG DISTANCES ONCE DEVELOPED. THE CELL OVER FAR WRN MD APPEARS TO BE BECOMING BETTER ORGANIZED WITH A HAIL THREAT. OTHER CU OF INTEREST WERE ACROSS NERN OH NEAR THE COLD FRONT. ADDITIONAL CELLS MAY FORM HERE AND TRACK SEWD WITH A HAIL AND WIND THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ORGANIZED MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM WITH A THREAT FOR SVR WIND GUSTS WILL APPROACH/CROSS THE OHIO RIVER DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE MCS THAT BROUGHT DMGG WIND GUSTS TO W-CNTRL OHIO CONTINUES TRACKING SSEWD/SEWD AT 50-55 KT...EXTENDING FROM JUST NORTH OF THE CINCINNATI TO NEAR WILMINGTON TO WASHINGTON COURT HOUSE. THIS LINE WILL CONTINUE TRACKING TOWARD THE OHIO RIVER...LIKELY CROSSING THE RIVER FROM NEAR/EAST OF CINCINNATI TO PORTSMOUTH BETWEEN 1630Z AND 1730Z. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY DEPICTS SOME FILTERED SUNSHINE IN ADVANCE OF THE LINE...CONTRIBUTING TO UPWARDS OF 2000 J/KG OF MLCAPE PER MODIFIED 12Z WILMINGTON OH RAOB. AND...WITH 35-45 KT OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR IN PLACE...CONTINUED FORWARD PROPAGATION OF THE MCS WITH A DMGG WIND THREAT IS EXPECTED. AS THE LINE RECENTLY PASSED THE WILMINGTON OHIO RADAR SITE...VWP DATA INDICATE 60 KT OF NWLY FLOW WITHIN THE 2.5-3 KM AGL LAYER...LIKELY IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE REAR-INFLOW JET FEEDING INTO THE BACKSIDE OF THE MCS. THIS ALSO HIGHLIGHTS THE POTENTIAL WIND THREAT APPROACHING THE OHIO RIVER. A NEW SVR TSTM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED DOWNSTREAM OF WW 508...PLEASE REFERENCE MCD 1564 FOR ADDITIONAL DETAILS. ..COHEN.. 07/24/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS WILL INCREASE ALONG THE COLD FRONT...AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE. A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED ALONG THE COLD FRONT...WITH HAIL INDICATED IN STORMS OVER FAR SRN ME. OTHER CELLS WERE FORMING ACROSS SRN VT AND NH...AND MAY EVENTUALLY MOVE INTO ERN MA. WITH LONG STRAIGHT HODOGRAPHS...THE MAIN THREAT WILL BE HAIL NEAR 1.00 INCH DIAMETER.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR SVR THUNDERSTORMS IS INCREASING OVER THE SRN APPALACHIANS AND ADJACENT PIEDMONT REGION...AND THE ISSUANCE OF A SVR TSTM WATCH IS POSSIBLE SOUTH OF WW/S 509 AND 510.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS OVER SWRN VA HAVE CONGLOMERATED INTO A MORE ORGANIZED LINE OVER SWRN VA...AND ADDITIONAL STORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP OVER THE SRN APPALACHIANS DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. DESPITE RELATIVELY WEAKER MID-LEVEL FLOW/WEAKER DEEP SHEAR COMPARED TO AREAS FARTHER NORTH...DEEP SHEAR SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR PERSISTENT MULTICELL CLUSTERS AND PERHAPS BOWING LINE SEGMENTS INTO THE AFTERNOON WHILE ADDITIONAL STORMS DEVELOP AMIDST 2500-3500 J/KG OF MLCAPE. AND...WITH DCAPE OVER 1000 J/KG...DMGG WIND GUSTS WILL BE OF CONCERN...ESPECIALLY IF A LARGER-SCALE COLD POOL EVOLVES. SVR HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ADDITIONAL STORMS MAY FORM WITHIN THE LOW PRESSURE TROUGH...WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL LIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TEMPERATURES HAVE RISEN INTO THE MID 90S F OVER VA AND SRN MD...WHILE DEWPOINTS REMAIN IN THE LOWER 70S F. VISIBLE IMAGERY RECENTLY INDICATES THAT STABLE WAVE CLOUDS WERE MIXING OUT...SUGGESTING THAT CAPPING IS BEING REMOVED. FURTHER HEATING IS LIKELY...WITH WILL ENHANCE SFC CONVERGENCE ALONG THE TROUGH AXIS. MOST MODEL SUGGEST A SEPARATE AREA OF DEVELOPMENT WILL TAKE PLACE IN THIS AREA BETWEEN 18-20Z. GIVEN VERY LARGE INSTABILITY AND AMPLE W TO NWLY FLOW ALOFT...EXPLOSIVE DEVELOPMENT WOULD OCCUR WITH STORMS QUICKLY BECOMING SEVERE WITH LARGE HAIL...THEN MERGING INTO SEWD MOVING CLUSTERS PRODUCING DAMAGING WIND...WITH SOME SIGNIFICANT GUSTS POSSIBLE. IF TCU BEGIN TO FORM IN THESE AREAS AS PREDICTED BY SEVERAL HIGH RESOLUTION MODELS...THE WATCH MAY NEED TO BE EXTENDED TO INCLUDE THE REST OF SERN VA AND FAR NERN NC. ..JEWELL.. 07/24/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN INCREASINGLY ORGANIZED...LEADING-LINE/TRAILING-STRATIFORM MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM WILL CONTINUE ADVANCING SWD/SEWD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON...WITH AN ACCOMPANYING THREAT FOR DMGG WIND GUSTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CAPPI DATA AT 7 KM SUGGEST THAT THE MCS...WHOSE LEADING LINE EXTENDS FROM JACKSON COUNTY WV TO LAWRENCE COUNTY KY TO NRN MONTGOMERY COUNTY KY...IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY ORGANIZED. A WELL-DEFINED TRANSITION ZONE FOLLOWING THE LEADING LINE HAS RECENTLY CROSSED THE OHIO RIVER FOLLOWING A BETTER-DEFINED BOWING SEGMENT/SURGE MOVING ACROSS ERN KY AND WRN WV. THIS MAY BE ACCOMPANIED BY AN INCREASED SVR WIND THREAT FROM CHARLESTON WV TO JACKSON KY DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. HOWEVER...STRATIFORM PRECIPITATION ACROSS FAR ERN KY...WRN WV...AND PARTS OF SWRN VA LEADING THE CONVECTIVE LINE MAY LIMIT BOUNDARY-LAYER DESTABILIZATION SUCH THAT THE SFC MANIFESTATION OF A REAR-INFLOW JET MAY BE LIMITED. REGARDLESS...STRENGTHENING STORM-SCALE PERTURBATIONS WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO DRIVE THE SVR-WIND THREAT TO THE SURFACE DESPITE THE LEADING PRECIP...AS WSWLY/WLY LOW-LEVEL INFLOW PER JACKSON KY VWP PROVIDES AN INFLUX OF UNSTABLE AIR CHARACTERIZED BY MLCAPE AOA 2500 J/KG ORIGINATING FROM CLOUD-FREE AREAS IN CNTRL KY. AND...FARTHER WEST IN CNTRL KY WEST OF MONTGOMERY COUNTY...OUTFLOW APPEARS TO BE SURGING AHEAD OF PARENT CONVECTION SUGGESTING MORE OF AN ANAFRONTAL CHARACTER TO THE WRN SEGMENT OF THE LINE. HOWEVER...AS THIS OUTFLOW INTERACTS WITH STRONG INSTABILITY...ADDITIONAL SVR STORMS MAY DEVELOP AT THE LEADING EDGE OF THE WRN FLANK OF THE COLD POOL ACCOMPANYING THE MCS IN CNTRL KY. ..COHEN.. 07/24/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR SVR WIND GUSTS ALONG WITH HEAVY RAINFALL WILL OCCUR IN ASSOCIATION WITH A MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM MOVING INTO THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS. ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT MAY OCCUR WEST OF THIS ACTIVITY IN CNTRL KY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LEADING EDGE OF AN MCS-RELATED COLD POOL ARCING FROM CNTRL TO SRN WV AND WWD INTO ERN KY WILL CONTINUE TO SURGE SWD TOWARD SWRN VA AND SERN KY DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. REFLECTIVITY DATA SUGGEST WEAKENING OF CONVECTIVE CORES OVER THE LEADING EDGE OF THE ERN FLANK OF THE COLD POOL. THIS IS THE RESULT OF LIMITED DOWNSTREAM BUOYANCY ASSOCIATED WITH EARLIER STRATIFORM PRECIPITATION. HOWEVER...STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL STILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE SURGE OF THE COLD POOL OWING TO THE RESIDUAL REAR INFLOW JET/MESOSCALE CIRCULATION. MEANWHILE...OVER THE WRN FLANK OF THE COLD POOL...WLY LOW-LEVEL INFLOW OF GREATER INSTABILITY -- MLCAPE OF 2000-2500 J/KG PER MODIFIED NASHVILLE 12Z RAOB -- SHOULD MAINTAIN UPDRAFT STRENGTH AND PERSISTENCE ACROSS ERN KY. SVR WIND GUSTS REMAIN POSSIBLE WITH THIS ACTIVITY...WHICH COULD SAG SWD INTO NERN TN. THIS MAY BE ADDRESSED WITH EXPANDING THE WW AREA SOUTHWARD. ALSO...THE WRN SEGMENT OF THE LINE HAS BECOME ORIENTED LARGELY PARALLEL TO 25-35 KT OF CLOUD-LAYER FLOW PER JACKSON KY/ROANOKE VA VWP DATA. THIS WILL ALLOW TRAINING OF MESO-BETA ELEMENTS...ALONG WITH PERSISTENCE OF HEAVY RAINFALL -- 1-2-IN/HR RAINFALL RATES. MEANWHILE...RECENT VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGES INDICATE A BOUNDARY-LAYER CUMULUS FIELD SWELLING NEAR AND SOUTH OF A RELATIVELY SLOWER-MOVING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. THIS BOUNDARY RECENTLY CROSSED LEXINGTON AND ALSO EXTENDS FARTHER NW TO 30 NNE OF LOUISVILLE. WITH OVER 3000 J/KG OF MLCAPE AMIDST LITTLE/NO CINH...AND WITH FORCING FOR ASCENT OFFERED BY THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...SVR STORMS WITH DMGG WINDS AND HAIL MAY DEVELOP FROM THE CUMULUS FIELD DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ..COHEN.. 07/24/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE...AND FILL IN OVER SERN VA...ERN NC AND PERHAPS NERN SC. A NEW WATCH IS LIKELY FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WITHIN THE HOUR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWS A WLY SURGE INCREASING CONVERGENCE ALONG AN AXIS FROM RIC SWWD INTO CNTRL NC. VIGOROUS STORMS HAVE BEEN INCREASING IN COVERAGE OVER NC...WITH NEW DEVELOPMENT NOW INTO SERN VA. STRONG INSTABILITY/HIGH PWAT...SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED/LONG LIVED SEVERE AND STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL ALL CONTRIBUTE TO A DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL THREAT WITH THESE STORMS UNTIL THEY EXIT THE COAST.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR ISOLATED SVR THUNDERSTORMS WILL EXIST THROUGH THE AFTERNOON HOURS...AND THE ISSUANCE OF A WW IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INSOLATION AND RELATIVELY STEEPER LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WITHIN A NARROW CORRIDOR ALONG AND EAST OF A SFC TROUGH AXIS -- ORIENTED NNE/SSW ACROSS ERN MT -- IS CONTRIBUTING TO MLCAPE VALUES OF 500-1000 J/KG. AND...WITH ENHANCED MID-LEVEL FLOW IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE GLANCING INFLUENCE OF A CLOSED LOW CROSSING ALBERTA AND SASKATCHEWAN...AROUND 35 KT OF DEEP SHEAR ARE INDICATED BY GLASGOW AND BISMARCK VWP DATA. THIS WILL SUPPORT A FEW VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS/ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE ELEMENTS WITH CONVECTION EVOLVING NEAR/EAST OF THE TROUGH AXIS. HOWEVER...THE CORRIDOR OF OVERLAP OF MARGINAL INSTABILITY AND MODERATE SHEAR IS BEING CONSTRICTED IN SPATIAL EXTENT BY ONGOING CLOUDINESS/SHOWERS/ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS FROM SWRN INTO CNTRL/N-CNTRL ND. HOWEVER...PRIOR TO CONVECTION REACHING THE REGION OF DECREASED BUOYANCY OWING TO CLOUD/RAIN-COOLED AIR...AN ISOLATED SVR THREAT MAY EVOLVE DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS...WITH SVR WIND GUSTS AND SVR HAIL THE PRIMARY CONCERNS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS MAY EXIST THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON. WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY OWING TO THE ANTICIPATED SPORADIC NATURE OF THE SVR THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE AIR MASS NEAR AND SOUTH OF A STALLING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM THE LOUISVILLE AREA TO 30 S DECATUR IL CONTINUES TO DESTABILIZE AS TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED TO THE UPPER 90S TO 104 DEGREES AMIDST SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MIDDLE 60S TO THE LOWER 70S. WITH 2500-3500 J/KG OF MLCAPE...A FEW STRONG TO SVR STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE AS CONVECTION DEVELOPS INVOF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AND ALONG SFC CONFLUENCE AXES LYING SOUTH OF THE BOUNDARY. DCAPE VALUES IN EXCESS OF 1000 J/KG INDICATE THAT INTENSE DOWNDRAFTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH COLLAPSING STORMS...ESPECIALLY GIVEN SFC DEWPOINT DEPRESSIONS IN EXCESS OF 35F IN MANY AREAS. ALSO...MARGINALLY SVR HAIL CANNOT BE RULED OUT. HOWEVER...WITH THE REGION DISPLACED TO THE SW OF THE PRIMARY BELT OF STRONG NWLYS...DEEP SHEAR SHOULD BE LIMITED...FOSTERING MORE OF A PULSE CONVECTIVE MODE. GIVEN THE GENERALLY DISORGANIZED NATURE OF THE CONVECTION...ANY INSTANCES OF SVR STORMS SHOULD BE SPORADIC.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WIND/HAIL THREAT INCREASING ACROSS NW INTO N-CNTRL SD. A WW MAY BE NEEDED WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR AS STORMS OVER NWRN SD TRACK E-NEWD AND INTENSIFY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS HAD DEVELOPED THIS AFTERNOON IN A MOIST/UNSTABLE AIRMASS AHEAD OF A SFC TROUGH. WEAK FORCING ACROSS A STATIONARY BOUNDARY FROM AN IMPULSE EJECTING NEWD ACROSS NE WY INTO THE WRN DAKOTAS WAS PROVIDING ADEQUATE LIFT TO OVERCOME WEAK CAPPING ACROSS NWRN SD. BULK SHEAR VALUES AROUND 35-45 KT SHOULD ALLOW FOR AT LEAST SEMI-ORGANIZED CONVECTION PERSISTING INTO THE EVENING HOURS AS STORMS CONTINUE E-NEWD. BASED ON RADAR TRENDS...IT IS APPARENT THAT STORMS ARE LIKELY NOT REACHING THEIR FULL POTENTIAL AT PRESENT DUE TO AFOREMENTIONED CAP/WARM MIDLEVELS. HOWEVER MODIFIED 18Z RAP RAOB USING OBSERVATIONS ACROSS NW INTO N-CNTRL SD SUGGEST STRONGER MLCAPE VALUES/DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER COULD LEAD TO DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL THREAT WITH STRONGER STORMS. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR POTENTIAL WW ISSUANCE OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR SO.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE NEED FOR A WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED...BUT A SHORT TERM SEVERE THREAT MAY DEVELOP ACROSS COLUMBIA/SUMTER AND ADJACENT PORTIONS OF THE CENTRAL SOUTH CAROLINA PIEDMONT DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. AND TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF AN INCREASING THREAT THAT COULD REQUIRE A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN INCREASE IN THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY IS ONGOING ACROSS THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF WESTERN SOUTH CAROLINA INTO THE LEE SURFACE TROUGH ACROSS THE PIEDMONT. WITH BOUNDARY LAYER CAPE REMAINING MODERATELY LARGE...AND CAPPING WEAK...POTENTIAL FOR FURTHER DEVELOPMENT WILL CONTINUE INTO THE 00-02Z TIME FRAME. SOME CONSOLIDATION OF ACTIVITY APPEARS POSSIBLE ACROSS THE COLUMBIA AND SUMTER AREAS...WHERE THE BOUNDARY LAYER REMAINS DEEPLY MIXED WITH TEMPERATURES IN THE MID/UPPER 90S AND DEW POINTS NEAR 70F. HEAVY PRECIPITATION LOADING AND SIZABLE SUB-CLOUD TEMPERATURE DEW POINT SPREADS MAY SUPPORT ONE OR TWO DOWNBURSTS WITH POTENTIALLY DAMAGING SURFACE GUSTS. IF COLD POOLS ARE ABLE TO MERGE...LIGHT NORTHWESTERLY MID-LEVEL FLOW MAY CONTRIBUTE TO SOUTHWARD PROPAGATION TOWARD THE COASTAL PLAIN THEREAFTER...BUT WEAK LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION AND SLOW BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING/STABILIZATION MAY LIMIT THE EXTENT OF THE SEVERE THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: HOWEVER...WEAKENING TRENDS TO ONGOING ACTIVITY AROUND LOUISVILLE MAY COMMENCE DURING THE 01-03Z TIME FRAME. IT CURRENTLY APPEARS THAT A NEW WW WILL NOT BE NEEDED...BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A 40-50 KT NORTHWESTERLY 500 MB JET STREAK DIGGING SOUTHWARD ACROSS THE OHIO VALLEY TOWARD THE CENTRAL/SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS IS CONTRIBUTING TO SUFFICIENT SHEAR TO SUPPORT ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. HOWEVER...CONVECTION HAS YET TO SHOW SUBSTANTIVE SIGNS OF CONSOLIDATION...PERHAPS DUE TO THE LACK OF STRONGER LOW-LEVEL WARM ADVECTION AND ASSOCIATED LARGE-SCALE ASCENT. VIGOROUS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT DOES CONTINUE TO DEVELOP WHERE LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE IS BECOMING ENHANCED IN THE UNSTABLE BOUNDARY LAYER ACROSS PARTS OF SOUTHERN INDIANA AND NORTH CENTRAL KENTUCKY...BUT THIS MAY BEGIN TO DIMINISH DURING THE 01-03Z TIME FRAME...AS INHIBITION STRENGTHENS FURTHER FOR SLOWLY COOLING BOUNDARY LAYER PARCELS. ..KERR.. 07/25/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE EVOLUTION OF AN INCREASINGLY ORGANIZED MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM APPEARS POSSIBLE DURING THE 06-9Z TIME FRAME...PARTICULARLY ACROSS PARTS OF WEST CENTRAL INTO NORTH CENTRAL MINNESOTA. OTHERWISE...LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL REMAIN POSSIBLE WITH SCATTERED ONGOING STORMS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: NEAR TERM DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL APPEARS GREATEST WITH THE SMALL STORM CLUSTER NOW SPREADING NORTH/NORTHEAST OF PIERRE. ACTIVITY APPEARS TO BE JUST NORTH OF THE SURFACE FRONTAL ZONE...BUT...IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO THE MORE STRONGLY HEATED BOUNDARY LAYER ENCOMPASSING MUCH OF SOUTHEASTERN SOUTH DAKOTA...A LAYER OF SIZABLE SUB-CLOUD TEMPERATURE DEW POINT SPREADS STILL LIKELY EXISTS. THIS ALSO NEARLY COINCIDES WITH THE WESTERN EDGE OF A STRENGTHENING SOUTHERLY LOW-LEVEL JET. BY THE 06-09Z TIME FRAME...SEVERE POTENTIAL MAY BEGIN TO BECOME MORE FOCUSED ON THE NORTHERN FRINGE OF MORE STRONGLY CAPPING ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR...ACROSS PARTS OF SOUTHEASTERN NORTH DAKOTA AND ADJACENT NORTHEASTERN SOUTH DAKOTA INTO NORTH CENTRAL MINNESOTA. THIS IS WHERE LOW-LEVEL WARM ADVECTION WILL BECOME ENHANCED...AND SUPPORTIVE OF A CONSOLIDATING/EXPANDING CONVECTIVE CLUSTER IN THE PRESENCE OF HIGH PRECIPITABLE WATER /APPROACHING 2 INCHES/ AND MODERATELY LARGE CAPE. HEAVY PRECIPITATION LOADING MAY CONTRIBUTE TO A STRONG DOWNBURST OR TWO. AIDED BY STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR...ASSOCIATED WITH WINDS VEERING FROM A NEAR SURFACE EASTERLY COMPONENT TO MODERATELY STRONG /30-40 KT/ WESTERLY AT 500 MB...AND A STRENGTHENING SURFACE COLD POOL... POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR THE EVOLUTION OF AN INCREASINGLY ORGANIZED MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM CAPABLE OF PRODUCING STRONG SURFACE GUSTS OVERNIGHT. ..KERR.. 07/25/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SMALL MCS THAT FORMED OVER EXTREME SERN KY INTO EXTREME SWRN VA HAS PRODUCED A COLD POOL AIDING IN AN INCREASE IN SEWD MOVEMENT /NEAR 40 KT/. LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE AS THIS ACTIVITY TRACKS SEWD THROUGH EXTREME SWRN VA/EXTREME NERN TN INTO WRN NC DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS /UNTIL 08-09Z/. GIVEN SPATIOTEMPORAL LIMITATIONS...A WW IS UNLIKELY AT THIS TIME. AS STORMS CONTINUE TO FORM OVER ERN KY WITH A TENDENCY TO TRAIN SEWD...RAINFALL RATES OF 1.5-2 INCH PER HOUR ARE LIKELY...GIVEN A RICHLY MOIST AIR MASS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY INDICATED A SMALL MCS THAT FORMED OVER EXTREME ERN/SERN KY INTO EXTREME SWRN VA BETWEEN 04-0530Z/ HAD PRODUCED HEAVY RAINFALL RATES /1-2+ IN/HR AS INDICATED BY RADAR ESTIMATES AND NESDIS SATELLITE ESTIMATES FOR BUCHANAN COUNTY VA/. ADDITIONAL STORMS HAVE BEGUN TO DEVELOP NWWD ACROSS ERN KY...WITH ALL OF THESE STORMS BEING FED BY W/NWLY LOW LEVEL WINDS PROVIDING AN INFLUX OF RESIDUAL MODERATE INSTABILITY RESIDING ACROSS KY AND MIDDLE/ERN TN. 35 KT NWLY MIDLEVEL WINDS ARE CONTRIBUTING TO SUFFICIENT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR FOR SOME ORGANIZATION AND SEWD MOVEMENT AS OBSERVED IN THE SWRN VA TSTM CLUSTER. THE DOWNSTREAM AIR MASS ACROSS WRN NC IS LESS UNSTABLE GIVEN TIME OF DAY AND EARLIER CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING. THE LAST FEW RUNS OF THE HRRR SUGGEST THE ERN KY/SWRN VA STORMS WILL TRACK SEWD...BUT WEAKEN AS THEY REACH AREAS OF GREATER DOWNSTREAM STABILIZATION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LINEAR MCS HAS BECOME BETTER ORGANIZED IN THE PAST HOUR ACROSS CENTRAL MN...AND IS NOW MOVING EWD AT 40 KT. THE RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS WILL LIKELY PERSIST INTO AREAS NEAR AND SW-SE OF DLH...INTO NW WI THROUGH THE EARLY MORNING HOURS. A NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL BE PROPOSED SHORTLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTIVE CLUSTER THAT FORMED EARLIER IN SE ND HAS MOVED EWD AND EVOLVED INTO A MORE N-S ORIENTED LINE...WITH EWD MOTION AT 40 KT. THE STORMS ARE MOVE ALONG THE N EDGE OF THE INSTABILITY GRADIENT...N OF THE SURFACE WARM FRONT AND EMBEDDED WITHIN A BELT OF 40-45 KT WLY MIDLEVEL FLOW CRESTING THE ERN PLAINS/MS VALLEY RIDGE. A FEED OF LOW 70S BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS AND MODERATE INSTABILITY WILL CONTINUE FROM THE SW ON A 30-40 KT LLJ. THUS...THE ENVIRONMENT WILL REMAIN SUPPORTIVE OF A DAMAGING WIND RISK THROUGH THE EARLY MORNING HOURS AS THE CONVECTION APPROACHES AREAS NEAR AND S OF DLH BY 0930Z...AND CONTINUES INTO NW WI THEREAFTER.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP GENERALLY N THROUGH W OF A LINE FROM GRANT TO HUBBARD COUNTIES MN. A LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUST OR TWO WILL BE POSSIBLE. HOWEVER...GIVEN WEAKER INSTABILITY OVER THIS REGION...THE OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE DIMINISHING...ALLOWING WW 516 TO EXPIRE AS SCHEDULED AT 09Z. A THREAT FOR HEAVY RAINFALL RATES APPROACHING 2 IN/HR WILL BE POSSIBLE FROM OTTER TAIL AND WADENA COUNTIES AS STORMS HAVE EVOLVED PARALLEL TO THE FRONT AND SHOULD TRAIN EWD WITHIN A RICHLY MOIST ENVIRONMENT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0825Z...REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED THE LEADING EXTENT OF THE CENTRAL/NRN MN MCS EXTENDING FROM POPE COUNTY MN INTO NERN MN /NEAR AND N OF DLH/. MEANWHILE...A LLJ HAS VEERED TO SWLY DURING THE LAST FEW HOURS WITH THE STRONGEST WAA OCCURRING ON THE NOSE OF THIS JET IN CENTRAL MN...WITH A CONTINUED LIKELIHOOD FOR NEW TSTM DEVELOPMENT TO THE W OF THE LEADING BAND OF CONVECTION. 08Z SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWED AN AREA OF LOW PRESSURE NEAR ABR WITH A SECOND LOW NEAR 9V9 /CHAMBERLAIN SD/. A WARM FRONT EXTENDED ENEWD FROM THE ABR LOW THROUGH CENTRAL MN TO S OF DLH AND INTO EXTREME NWRN WI. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 40-50 KT WITH VECTORS ORIENTED PARALLEL TO THE FRONT IN WEST CENTRAL MN WILL MAINTAIN THE POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL LINE SEGMENTS...AND LOCALLY STRONGER WINDS. ..PETERS.. 07/25/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS REMAINS ACROSS WW 517...WHILE THE OVERALL THREAT COVERAGE THAT WARRANTED THE ISSUANCE OF THIS WATCH APPEARS TO HAVE UNDERGONE SUBSTANTIAL WEAKENING. IF DIMINISHING TRENDS CONTINUE...THEN THIS WATCH MAY BE CANCELLED PRIOR TO 13Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN RADAR AND SATELLITE IMAGERY DURING THE LAST 1-2 HOURS INDICATED A LARGE MCS MOVING EWD ACROSS CENTRAL AND NERN MN INTO FAR NWRN WI AND WRN LAKE SUPERIOR. AN APPARENT MCV AND/OR MIDLEVEL IMPULSE ATTENDANT TO THIS SYSTEM WAS LOCATED IN NERN MN WITH THE LEADING BAND OF TSTMS TRAILING SWD THROUGH SRN LAKE COUNTY MN TO DOUGLAS COUNTY WI AND THEN SWWD ACROSS MUCH OF CENTRAL MN. STRONG LOW LEVEL WAA LOCATED WITHIN THE EXIT REGION OF A 40-45 KT SWLY LLJ EXTENDING INTO EAST CENTRAL/NERN MN AND NWRN WI TO WRN UPPER MS WILL MAINTAIN ONGOING FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS THIS MORNING. ALTHOUGH BULK SHEAR OF 35-50 KT REMAINS SUFFICIENT FOR ORGANIZED STORMS...A FAIRLY SUBSTANTIAL REDUCTION IN AVAILABLE INSTABILITY WILL TEND TO LIMIT THE OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT. FARTHER W...ASCENT OVER NERN SD WITHIN THE EXIT REGION OF A 40-50 KT SWLY MIDLEVEL JET ATTENDANT TO AN IMPULSE MOVING NEWD THROUGH CENTRAL SD WILL SUPPORT ADDITIONAL CONVECTION/TSTMS FROM NERN SD INTO WEST CENTRAL MN. ALTHOUGH BULK SHEAR OF 40-50 KT IS SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED STORMS...THE FACT THAT ONGOING ACTIVITY IS MOVING INTO A REGION OF WEAKER INSTABILITY SUGGESTS THE POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL STRONGER/SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS SHOULD BE LOW. MEANWHILE...RADAR IMAGERY AND LIGHTNING DATA ALSO SHOWED TWO BANDS OF STORMS EXTENDING NNW-SSE FROM NRN-SRN WI AND FAR NERN IL. THIS ACTIVITY APPEARS TO BE LOCATED PARALLEL TO A COUPLE OF 850 MB THERMAL GRADIENTS AND IS BEING SUPPORTED BY LOW LEVEL WAA...THE ERN EXTENT OF A STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATE PLUME. MODEST EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR /20-30 KT/ AND WEAK INSTABILITY SHOULD LIMIT THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT AS THIS ACTIVITY PROGRESSES EWD THIS MORNING. ..PETERS.. 07/25/2012
